prompt: Create an original production texture atlas for a painterly Japanese fantasy roguelike: ancient overgrown limestone garden boundary with genuinely RAISED sculpted stone masses. Exact 2 by 2 equally sized SQUARE opaque swatches, no borders/gutters/text, fill each cell all the way to its edges. TOP LEFT: horizontal course of upright chunky ancient limestone masonry, FRONT/SIDE material, strongly modeled vertical faces of standing irregular weathered limestone blocks interlocked with roots and sparse moss. A few large blocks at varied heights and dark narrow recesses, soft light from upper left, strong readable volume. No ground or backdrop or isolated pillars, a continuous connected masonry material. TOP RIGHT: WALL TOP material viewed from elevated almost top-down orthographic camera, densely overlapping limestone boulder crowns and gnarled roots, clearly sculpted convex masses with rounded ridges, crevices and soft occlusion. NOT flat flagstones or paving, no regular grid or flat slab, no broad featureless plateau. Entire cell is dense solid wall mass, absolutely no alpha cutouts or floor around silhouettes. BOTTOM LEFT: darker matching solid rocky wall-interior material, natural irregular stacked limestone ribs and ancient tree roots, olive moss confined to cracks, organic stone volumes, no planar floor or dirt. BOTTOM RIGHT: matching NARROW TOP CAP material of a ruined garden wall, the crowns of several raised worn blocks with slightly rounded tops and pale edges, irregular fracture seams and sparse moss, viewed from above, solid continuous surface. Shared muted warm olive gray limestone palette, warm brown roots, subdued moss. Cohesive hand-painted sculpted 2.5D game art, soft natural rendering readable at small sizes, not photography, not pixel art, no camera perspective convergence, no cast shadows beyond an imagined silhouette. These are RAW MATERIAL SWATCHES to be clipped to connected wall geometry, not independent wall tiles or scenery dioramas. Do not paint square tile outlines, empty gaps, black voids, UI, characters, flowers, water, paths, floors or surrounding terrain. Keep stone features large enough to read but vary their forms: impression of stone rising up, not a flat textured tabletop.
references: Design observations from five Shiren 6 screenshots supplied directly by the user in chat. Their artwork is not copied or used as game textures. New material is original generated art.
layout: 2x2 opaque atlas: top-left upright wall faces; top-right sculpted boulder crowns; bottom-left rocky interior; bottom-right raised cap. Runtime maps generated textures to shared geometry.
scope: Review-only ridge mode; published default remains low wall / pitch 0.82.
